exercises.title: Tactical Range: Distance to Target
exercises.description: Calculate distance from base (0,0) to target (30,40). Use Pythagorean theorem. Print rounded to 2 decimals.
exercises.starterCode:
import math
base_x, base_y = 0, 0
target_x, target_y = 30, 40
exercises.solution:
import math
base_x, base_y = 0, 0
target_x, target_y = 30, 40
distance = math.sqrt((target_x - base_x)**2 + (target_y - base_y)**2)
print(f'{distance:.2f}')

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Multi-Waypoint Mission
exercises.description: ADVANCED NAV: Calculate total flight distance for route: (0,0)→(60,0)→(60,80)→(0,80)→back to(0,0). Use distance formula for each segment. Print total rounded to 2 decimals.
exercises.solution:
import math
route = [(0,0), (60,0), (60,80), (0,80), (0,0)]
total = 0
for i in range(len(route)-1):
    x1, y1 = route[i]
    x2, y2 = route[i+1]
    dist = math.sqrt((x2-x1)**2 + (y2-y1)**2)
    total += dist
print(f'{total:.2f}')
